description: Get the user's recent trades with cursor pagination, optionally filtered to one account or one status group. Use refresh=true to request fresh brokerage sync when eligible.

account_id.description: Only return trades for this brokerage account. Omit for every account.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous get_trades response. Pass next_cursor to continue paginating older trades.

limit.description: Number of trades to return per page. Omit for 12.

refresh.description: When true, requests the freshest available brokerage data. Real-time refresh requires a Pro plan and has a 1 minute per-account cooldown. Omit or false to return the last synced data.

status.description: Only return trades in this status group. Omit or pass all for every status.

name: get_trades
title: Get Trades
